# A converted script's plate: the plate comes before the expression (the order the studio takes),
# and {var=...} holds a placeholder that the References row maps to its variable.
#
# CREATE IN THE PROJECT BEFORE IMPORTING
#   Cast        Anna
#   Variables   anna_plate text
#   References  REF_ANNA_PLATE = anna_plate
@set anna_plate = "Anders"

@label k1
Anna as "{var=REF_ANNA_PLATE}" (determined): Hello.
Anna as "Anna" (sad): Goodbye.
@end Done
